name: Ysolde Marr
title: Harvest-Warden
blurb: A Vael steward who has fed four worlds and emptied two. Her ledgers balance; her conscience does not.

name: Tavin Oakshade
title: Commodore
blurb: Ferron gunnery officer who believes every problem has a calibre.

name: Seris Vale
title: Envoy-Captain
blurb: A Concord envoy equally at home in a senate or on a bridge. Never raises her voice; never needs to.

name: Dorran Pike
title: Factor
blurb: Syndicate factor who can price a planet by its weather. Loyal for exactly as long as he is paid.

name: Ilex Nine
title: Archivist
blurb: A fragment of the Chorus that chose a single body to see what research feels like from the inside.

name: Kaveh Drift
title: Wayfinder
blurb: Born on an Ark and never slept planetside. Knows every lane by its hum.

name: Mara Quell
title: Shieldmaster
blurb: A drifter who rebuilt a derelict cruiser alone over nine years and then sold it for a song. Keeps the song.

name: Ottan Rhee
title: Magistrate
blurb: Retired magistrate with a gift for being liked by people who disagree with him.

name: Brenna Sol
title: Yardmistress
blurb: Ran the largest slipway in the Covenant until she got bored of building the same ship.

name: Hale Vantor
title: Privateer
blurb: Formerly of the Corsair Compact, allegedly reformed. Flies like he is still being chased.

name: Nyx Amaranth
title: Chartmaster
blurb: A Chorus tactician who treats battles as proofs. Dislikes losing the way others dislike paradoxes.

name: Veyr Tollan
title: Settler-General
blurb: Has founded eleven colonies and abandoned ten. Calls it practice.
